name: online-chess
description: Online Chess Platform with Real-time Multiplayer and Custom Minimax AI

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=apps/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/server && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/server && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
